seo_title: {app} — Secure, Zero-Knowledge Encrypted Note & File Sharing
seo_description: Share passwords, notes, and files securely with end-to-end encryption. Your data is encrypted in the browser — the server never sees your content. Free, open-source, no account required.
seo_keywords: encrypted notes, secure file sharing, zero-knowledge encryption, password sharing, burn after reading, end-to-end encryption, self-hosted, privacy, secret sharing, encrypted messaging
view_description: This note is encrypted. It is decrypted in your browser, never on the server.
create_sub: Encrypted in your browser, then erased automatically.
note_placeholder: Write or paste what you want to share…
drop_hint: Drop your files to attach them
secret_note_hint: Will be shown as a password to copy
pw_extra_hint: send it through another channel than the link
error_empty_content: Write something or attach a file first.
error_file_too_large: File too large. Maximum {size} per file.
send_sub: Everything happens in your browser: the server only receives encrypted data.
send_keep_open: Keep this tab open until the upload finishes.
key_stays_here: The key never leaves this device.
ok_sub: Anyone with this link can read the note: share it only with your recipient.
ok_sub_pw: Send the link and the password through two different channels.
ok_qr_title: Scan to open the note on another device
ok_qr_warning: The QR code holds the decryption key: show it only to your recipient.
qr_alt: QR code for the share link
ok_unload_warning: This link won't be shown again: copy it before leaving the page.
ok_pw_hint: Send it through another channel: SMS, Signal, a call.
ok_rule: Erased after {reads} or in {expiry}, whichever comes first.
ok_manage_hint: Changed your mind? Keep the deletion link to erase the note before it is read.
un_sub: It will be decrypted here, in your browser.
un_burn_body: The note will be destroyed as soon as you open it. Take the time to read or copy it.
burn_password_warning: One attempt only: a wrong password will destroy it too.
un_pw_empty: Enter the password you received with the link.
error_wrong_password: Wrong password or invalid key. That attempt counted as a read.
error_wrong_password_left_one: Wrong password. That attempt counted as a read: 1 left.
error_wrong_password_left_other: Wrong password. That attempt counted as a read: {count} left.
error_wrong_password_last: Wrong password. That was its last read: the note has been destroyed.
error_burned_wrong_password: Wrong password. This note was read-once and has now been destroyed.
rv_sub_gone: It has just been erased from the server: this page is its only copy.
rv_sub_secret_gone: The note has just been erased from the server: copy it now.
rv_sub_left_one: 1 more read possible before it is erased.
rv_sub_left_other: {count} more reads possible before it is erased.
rv_sub_limited: It stays available until its last read or its expiry.
not_found_description: It may have expired, reached its last read, or been deleted by its author.
link_incomplete_description: This link is missing its decryption key. Copy the full link, including everything after the # sign.
unavailable_description: The note could not be reached. This is a connection problem, not a deleted note — try again in a moment.
rate_limited_description: Too many notes were opened from your network in the last minute. Nothing was read or deleted — wait a minute, then reload this page.
manage_description: Erase this note for good, before it is read.
note_deleted_sub: It has been erased from the server.
manage_invalid_token: This deletion link is incomplete: its token is missing.
